title: Reusable context and provider choice are related
text: Levie connects fragmented enterprise data with the need for company-specific context and discusses interest in multiple models. The design question is which context, tools and definitions should remain under company control when the model changes.
qualification: Interest in multiple providers is not proof that switching is cheap or that a multimodel design is necessary for every use case.
